author: National Geographic
description:
Join National Geographic and journalist Mariana van Zeller to investigate black market operations around the globe in this MEGA episode. Featuring three, full episodes: 

Body Parts
Mariana exposes how black market operators are profiting from the sale of stolen human remains on secret marketplaces in the U.S. and beyond. 

Apes
Mariana heads to the Congo to investigate the illegal trade in wild apes that have them on the brink of extinction. 

Hash Smugglers
Mariana tracks the illicit path of hashish from Morocco into Europe — a world of shadowy dealers, lightning-fast smuggling boats and endless wealth. 

Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller | S4
